title: Personalization Engine
description: Turn a generic email template into personalized variants by mapping recipient signals to message variables, with example fills for 2-3 recipient profiles

children.text: Turn a generic email template into personalized messages by mapping what you know about recipients to targeted message variables.

### Demographic Signals
- Job title, seniority, function
- Company size, industry, location

### Behavioral Signals
- Prior interaction with your product or content (visited a page, opened a prior email)
- Existing customer or past participant
- Applied or inquired about something specific

### Situational Signals
- Career or business stage
- Timeline urgency (deadline approaching)
- Prior interaction state (never replied, said "later", active thread)

### Intent Signals
- Specific interest expressed
- Price sensitivity signals
- Questions asked previously
From the user's input, list what is known about the recipient or recipient segment. Map each piece of information to a signal category above.

For each signal, define a personalization variable. Example structure:

```
{{hook}} =
  - If [condition A]: "[value A]"
  - If [condition B]: "[value B]"
  - Default: "[fallback value]"

{{urgency_line}} =
  - If deadline < 2 weeks: "This closes on [date]."
  - If deadline > 2 weeks: "The next round kicks off in [month]."
  - If no deadline: "[offer description] runs on a rolling basis."
```

Define as many variables as the template has natural personalization points.
Take the base email and insert variables at natural points. Show the filled-in version for 2-3 distinct recipient profiles so the user can see range.

```
## Variable Map
| Variable | Condition | Value |
|----------|-----------|-------|
| {{hook}} | [condition] | "[value]" |
| ... | | |

## Example: Recipient Profile A, [describe]
[full personalized email]

## Example: Recipient Profile B, [describe]
[full personalized email]

## Example: Recipient Profile C, [describe, if useful]
[full personalized email]
```
